headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 15, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, while the Cincinnati Reds secured a narrow 1-0 victory over the Miami Marlins. The Pittsburgh Pirates took down the Boston Red Sox 8-4, and the Chicago White Sox defeated the Detroit Tigers 9-5.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams, with Vladimir Guerrero Jr. being placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion. Abner Uribe, Colt Emerson, Davis Martin, Matt Chapman, Trevor McDonald, Garrett Whitlock, and James Outman have also been placed on the injured list with various injuries.

The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox as part of a trade involving the August 3 Adley Rutschman deal. The Kansas City Royals also made a trade, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in 3-0 Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 loss to the Chicago Cubs, with the Cubs' pitching staff shutting out the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Thrilling 1-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a narrow win over the Miami Marlins with Chase Burns leading the way on the mound, tossing 7.0 innings with 8 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Eugenio Suárez delivered a crucial double in the game, driving in the winning run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-8 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Miguel Vargas leading the charge at the plate. Vargas hit two home runs, including his 27th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **Vladimir Guerrero Jr. Lands on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox on August 12, 2026, as part of a trade involving the August 3 Adley Rutschman deal.
